test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man types at the rate of 35 words per minute. How long will it take for him to type 987 words?
solution:
**Given:**

Words typed per minute = 35 words

Total words to type = 987 words

**Formula used:**

Time = dfrac{{Total words}}{{Words per minute}}

**Calculations:**

Time = dfrac{987}{35}

⇒ Time = 28.2 minutes

⇒ Time = 28 minutes and 0.2 × 60 seconds

⇒ Time = 28 minutes and 12 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
